scope: Device testing, hosted inference, source provenance and evidence-grounded answering

sources.title: Running your app on simulated or physical devices
sources.locator: Overview; Set up code signing for physical devices
sources.finding: Simulator performance can differ from actual hardware. Xcode can launch the app on a paired physical device after signing is configured.
sources.projectUse: Collect the task export, restart outcome and model timing from the owner's iPhone Air. Tag simulator and Linux results separately.

sources.title: Developer account overview
sources.locator: Enable a personal team in Xcode
sources.finding: A personal Apple Account can test apps on the owner's devices through Xcode. Personal Team provisioning profiles expire seven days after issuance.
sources.projectUse: Try the free Personal Team route for a device build. A paired Mac with Xcode and the physical phone are dependencies for this route.

sources.title: Workers Bindings
sources.finding: A Worker can invoke a hosted model through an AI binding. The run method takes the model identifier and an input object.
sources.projectUse: For a hosted smoke test, retain the requested model, attempt identifier, response and error status. The existing note round trip establishes storage only.

sources.title: Workers AI pricing
sources.finding: The free allocation is 10,000 neurons per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC. The Workers Paid plan can incur charges above that allocation.
sources.projectUse: Check the owner's available balance and plan before a hosted run. Count model usage separately from HTTP requests and stop at the available free allocation.

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.finding: PROV-O distinguishes a link to primary evidence from a link to an earlier revision of an entity.
sources.projectUse: Keep the upstream URL, retrieval date and revision lineage when a research note changes. The original note remains attributable.
sources.topics: provenance, primary evidence, source revisions and attribution

sources.title: Web Annotation Data Model
sources.finding: A text quote selector identifies a passage using exact text. Context immediately before and after the passage can disambiguate repeated wording.
sources.projectUse: Store a heading or short passage locator with each claim. Check it again if the publisher revises the page.

sources.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
sources.finding: ALCE evaluates answers with citations across three dimensions: fluency, correctness and citation quality.
sources.projectUse: Score the answer and its supporting source separately. A readable answer can still cite the wrong document.

sources.publisher: Rajpurkar, Jia and Liang, ACL Anthology
sources.title: Know What You Don’t Know: Unanswerable Questions for SQuAD
sources.finding: The authors include plausible questions that cannot be answered from the supplied passage. Success requires recognizing when the passage offers insufficient evidence.
sources.projectUse: Withhold the supporting document on paired examples and score an explicit insufficient-evidence answer. Report false answers when evidence is absent.

decisions.title: How the native evaluation suite scores exact answers
decisions.topics: native evaluator, literal output, extra space, whitespace, line break, trailing newline, grading policy, historical results

revisions.finding: Suite 1.0.0 trimmed surrounding whitespace and newlines before comparing a completed answer. Preserve that recorded score when reading a historical attempt.
In draft PR #254, suite 1.1.0 requires a completed answer with the exact expected UTF-8 bytes. An extra newline or space fails. Older attempts retain their recorded suite version and score.
